Combobox

A combobox is a searchable select that combines a text input with a dropdown list. It supports single and multi-select, option groups, async loading, and custom rendering.

Basic Combobox

A searchable select with keyboard navigation.

HTML
<div class="zak-combobox" style="position: relative;">
  <input type="text" class="zak-input" placeholder="Select a language..." autocomplete="off" role="combobox" aria-expanded="false" aria-haspopup="listbox">
  <div class="zak-combobox-dropdown" role="listbox" style="position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 0; right: 0;"></div>
</div>

Multi-Select

Select multiple options displayed as tags.

Option Groups

Group related options under headings.

Async Loading

Show a loading indicator while fetching options from a remote source.

Loading...

Disabled Options

Some options can be disabled and are not selectable.

Demo JavaScript

JavaScript
var languages = ['JavaScript','TypeScript','Python','Java','C#','Go','Rust','Ruby','PHP','Swift','Kotlin','Dart','Scala','Elixir','Clojure'];
var skills = ['HTML','CSS','JavaScript','TypeScript','React','Vue','Angular','Node.js','Python','Django','Flask','SQL','MongoDB','Redis','Docker','Kubernetes'];
var cities = {
  'USA': ['New York','Los Angeles','Chicago','Houston','Phoenix'],
  'Europe': ['London','Paris','Berlin','Madrid','Rome'],
  'Asia': ['Tokyo','Shanghai','Mumbai','Seoul','Bangkok']
};
var asyncUsers = ['Alice Johnson','Bob Smith','Carol White','David Brown','Eva Martinez','Frank Lee','Grace Kim','Henry Davis'];
var plans = [
  {name:'Free', disabled: false},
  {name:'Starter', disabled: false},
  {name:'Pro', disabled: false},
  {name:'Enterprise', disabled: true},
  {name:'Legacy', disabled: true}
];

function renderComboItems(dropdown, items, input, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  var q = input.value.toLowerCase();
  var filtered = items.filter(function (i) {
    var label = typeof i === 'object' ? i.name : i;
    return label.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1;
  });
  dropdown.innerHTML = filtered.length ? filtered.map(function (i) {
    var label = typeof i === 'object' ? i.name : i;
    var disabled = typeof i === 'object' ? i.disabled : false;
    var cls = disabled ? 'padding:0.5rem 1rem;cursor:not-allowed;color:var(--zak-text-muted);opacity:0.5;' : 'padding:0.5rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;';
    var evts = disabled ? '' : ' onmouseover="this.style.background=\'var(--zak-bg-hover)\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'\'"';
    return '<div class="zak-combobox-item" data-disabled="' + disabled + '" style="' + cls + '"' + evts + '>' + label + '</div>';
  }).join('') : '<div style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;color:var(--zak-text-muted);font-size:0.875rem;">No results</div>';
  dropdown.style.display = 'block';
  dropdown.querySelectorAll('.zak-combobox-item').forEach(function (item) {
    item.addEventListener('click', function () {
      if (item.dataset.disabled === 'true') return;
      input.value = item.textContent;
      dropdown.style.display = 'none';
    });
  });
}

function renderGroupedDropdown(dropdown, groups, input) {
  var q = input.value.toLowerCase();
  var html = '';
  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function (group) {
    var items = groups[group].filter(function (i) { return i.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; });
    if (items.length) {
      html += '<div style="padding:0.375rem 1rem;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--zak-text-muted);margin-top:0.25rem;">' + group + '</div>';
      items.forEach(function (i) {
        html += '<div class="zak-combobox-item" style="padding:0.5rem 1rem 0.5rem 1.5rem;cursor:pointer;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'var(--zak-bg-hover)\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'\'">' + i + '</div>';
      });
    }
  });
  dropdown.innerHTML = html || '<div style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;color:var(--zak-text-muted);font-size:0.875rem;">No results</div>';
  dropdown.style.display = 'block';
  dropdown.querySelectorAll('.zak-combobox-item').forEach(function (item) {
    item.addEventListener('click', function () { input.value = item.textContent; dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
  });
}

// Basic combobox
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('combo-basic-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('combo-basic-dropdown');
  input.addEventListener('input', function () { renderComboItems(dropdown, languages, input); });
  input.addEventListener('focus', function () { renderComboItems(dropdown, languages, input); });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#combo-basic')) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
})();

// Multi-select combobox
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('combo-multi-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('combo-multi-dropdown');
  var tagsContainer = document.getElementById('combo-multi-tags');
  var selected = [];
  function renderTags() {
    tagsContainer.innerHTML = selected.map(function (s) {
      return '<span class="zak-badge" style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.25rem;margin:2px;">' + s + '<button onclick="removeMultiTag(\'' + s + '\')" style="background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0;font-size:1rem;line-height:1;color:var(--zak-text-muted);">&times;</button></span>';
    }).join('');
  }
  window.removeMultiTag = function (tag) {
    selected = selected.filter(function (s) { return s !== tag; });
    renderTags();
  };
  input.addEventListener('input', function () {
    var q = input.value.toLowerCase();
    var filtered = skills.filter(function (s) { return s.toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1 && selected.indexOf(s) === -1; });
    dropdown.innerHTML = filtered.length ? filtered.map(function (s) {
      return '<div class="zak-combobox-item" style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;cursor:pointer;" onmouseover="this.style.background=\'var(--zak-bg-hover)\'" onmouseout="this.style.background=\'\'">' + s + '</div>';
    }).join('') : '<div style="padding:0.5rem 1rem;color:var(--zak-text-muted);font-size:0.875rem;">No results</div>';
    dropdown.style.display = 'block';
    dropdown.querySelectorAll('.zak-combobox-item').forEach(function (item) {
      item.addEventListener('click', function () {
        selected.push(item.textContent);
        renderTags();
        input.value = '';
        dropdown.style.display = 'none';
        input.focus();
      });
    });
  });
  input.addEventListener('focus', function () { input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#combo-multi')) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
})();

// Groups combobox
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('combo-groups-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('combo-groups-dropdown');
  input.addEventListener('input', function () { renderGroupedDropdown(dropdown, cities, input); });
  input.addEventListener('focus', function () { renderGroupedDropdown(dropdown, cities, input); });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#combo-groups')) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
})();

// Async combobox
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('combo-async-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('combo-async-dropdown');
  var loading = document.getElementById('combo-async-loading');
  var timer;
  input.addEventListener('input', function () {
    clearTimeout(timer);
    loading.style.display = 'block';
    dropdown.style.display = 'none';
    timer = setTimeout(function () {
      loading.style.display = 'none';
      renderComboItems(dropdown, asyncUsers, input);
    }, 800);
  });
  input.addEventListener('focus', function () { input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#combo-async')) { dropdown.style.display = 'none'; loading.style.display = 'none'; } });
})();

// Disabled options combobox
(function () {
  var input = document.getElementById('combo-disabled-input');
  var dropdown = document.getElementById('combo-disabled-dropdown');
  input.addEventListener('input', function () { renderComboItems(dropdown, plans, input); });
  input.addEventListener('focus', function () { renderComboItems(dropdown, plans, input); });
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (!e.target.closest('#combo-disabled')) dropdown.style.display = 'none'; });
})();
